Third Reprint AUGUST 2000 

( Incorporating Amendment No l) 



IS: 1225 -1972 

(Reaffirmed 1 996) 



Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

LEATHER PICKING BANDS FOR LOOMS 

( First Revision ) 



(Reaffirmed-2012) 



1. Scope — Prescribes requirements of leather picking bands, plain or hairy made from ox or buffalo 
hide. 

2. Material — Ox or buffalo hide chrome or vegetable and oil tanned as may have been agreed upon 
between the buyer and the seller or as may have been declated or marked. 

3. Requirements — All the bands in cut lengths, butt lengths or intermediate lengths are generally of 
comparable quality as long as they are cut from the butt portion of the hide. 

3.1 Dimensions — See Table 1 . 



TABLE 1 DIMENSIONS OF OX AND BUFFALO HIDE PICKING BANDS, PLAIN AND HAIRY

Note — All picking bands in a lot shall be either plain or hairy and cut bands or butt bands as may have 
been agreed upon between the buyer and the seller or as may have been declared or marked. 



3.2 Physical and Chemical Requirements — Irrespective of whether the bands in a lot are plain or hairy, 
the bands shall comply with the applicable requirements of Table 2.

IS: 1225- 1972 

3.3 Freedom from Defects — Picking bands shall be visually free from warble holes, deep fly cuts, 
bacterial damages or any other defect likely to affect their life or usefulness. 

4. Marking — All packages shall bear the following information: 

a) Name of the material; 

b) Manufacturer's name, initials or trade-mark, if any; 

c) Net weight of the content; and 

d) Code number to trace back the history of production. 

4.1 Cross (x) on the butt end and punch (o) on the shoulder end shall be marked on each picking band. 
Note — Usually butt end Is tied to the picker to obtain a longer working life of picking band. 

4.2 Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



Reprography Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India
